title: edit_ops
description: Source-preserving edit operations applied to figure_model.json. Frozen interface v1.0 (work/CONTRACT.md). Applied by `run.py edit`; the model is the single source of truth, so an edit is a model patch plus a redraw, never an SVG post-processing hack.

target.description: ent:<id> | rel:<id> | lg:<id> | cont:<id> | dotted.path (e.g. figure.title.text, data.units.fold_change)

value.description: New value. For add_entity/add_relation an object with at least an id.

source_refs.description: Why the new value is scientifically justified; required in spirit for any label/number change.

$comment: Allowed targets: rename_label/set_label/set_color/set_style/set_unit/set_attribute accept ent:/rel:/lg:/cont:/dotted paths; remove_entity/remove_relation accept the element target only. update_data replaces model.data fields (e.g. value={'series': [...], 'rows': [...]}); after any edit the whole model is re-validated, so an edit that introduces an unverifiable label or a legend/data mismatch fails the gate instead of silently shipping.
